title: Home's last two routing decisions recorded, and Claude's blind labels for the routing model
request: The owner: close the Home plan's open items without waiting (the routing collector's gaps, no real routing labels: use Claude labels, the browser check, the gate's rules-alone check, the budget).
spec: request.suggestion and request.tool as ledger points with labels from what the person does; a blind Claude labeller for unlabelled routing examples, silver and apart; the browser check of the owner's two sentences.
plan: Ledger points in dclab_core with their notes (workflow labels, conformance) and the studio's capture
Wire them into Home's route, open_track, the segments answer, choose_intent and the outcome
A routing_labeler purpose, prompt and command; the routing set reads its answers as silver

decisions.decision: The suggestion's record id kept apart (suggestion_record), route_suggestion unchanged
decisions.why: other code reads route_suggestion as 'a suggestion was offered'; a record id there would read as an offer

decisions.decision: Claude's routing labels in the store's own file, never a ledger
decisions.why: the owner's rule: silver labels apart from people's and weighted lower; the routing set fills a label from it only where no person's or written label stands

decisions.decision: Claude reads the person's words, never the blind view of decision_labeler
decisions.why: a routing decision's state holds counts and codes only: from it alone the kind of help cannot be read

decisions.decision: Scripted examples labelled only up to 40 per point
decisions.why: 4,626 next-question records are test traffic; a census would cost about EUR 40 for little
the owner agreed the budget be raised for these runs

change: dclab_core 0.142.0: ledger points request.suggestion and request.tool (workflow_labels and conformance notes; routing_example listed in conformance). dclab_rnd: capture.suggestion_read, suggestion_taken, tool_chosen and track_outcome's more; Home's route, open_track, _tool, the segments answer, choose_intent(by_person) and acted (a track judged only by its own actions); store.routing_labels with the routing_labeler purpose and prompt; the routing set reads Claude's labels as silver.

findings.defect: A result nobody judged was labelled kept on a new track
findings.scenario: An analysis answer saved, the person switches to reporting and a dashboard is produced: the verdict read every action of the draft and labelled the reporting suggestion none and its tool dashboard by the person.
findings.cause: acted read the draft's whole action list for the current track (since 36.2, for the exit and intent labels too).
findings.fix: move_to keeps where a track's actions start; acted reads only the actions since then.

findings.defect: Home's own move to the project path counted as the person taking a suggestion
findings.scenario: Segments and a churn wish in one request; on analysis the suggestion names prediction; the person answers new groups and Home moves the draft to the prediction path: the suggestion and the intent reading were labelled prediction by the person.
findings.cause: the segments answer called choose_intent, which labels as the person's choice.
findings.fix: choose_intent(by_person=False) from the segments answer labels nothing; the person's tool choice still labels request.tool.

findings.defect: A rule's tool record disagreed with itself
findings.scenario: New groups chosen, then the person moves away and back to prediction: the record says the rule used segmentation_project while the rule's answer says ml_project.
findings.cause: _tool passed the track's default tool as the rule's answer.
findings.fix: the rule's answer is the tool it recorded.

findings.defect: The routing_example contract had no conformance entry
findings.scenario: tests/test_conformance.py failed on main after P8's commit.
findings.cause: the contract was added without its line in CONTRACT_ADAPTERS.
findings.fix: listed as library-only: the main product has no Home front door.

findings.defect: The ledger refused the suggestion record
findings.scenario: The suggestion's rule name was put in the decision's state.
findings.cause: a state holds only its contract's fields: the guard that keeps table values out.
findings.fix: the rule's name goes in the answer's reason.

measurements.name: Browser check of the owner's two sentences (Playwright Chromium, downloaded with the owner's yes)
measurements.gate: an open question with six kinds of help, no ML panel; segments get their two ways

outcome: Every Home routing decision now has a ledger point and a label from what the person does; the routing set can take Claude's blind labels as silver.
lessons: A move the system makes for the person must never be recorded as the person's choice
A verdict must read only the actions of the thing it judges
risks: Claude's silver labels teach Claude's reading: they are kept apart and never promote a model alone
